entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Shall we send our calling card?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: We know where the Treasure is,[n]and the sooner the better.
entries.uk: Ми знаємо, де Скарб,[n]і що раніше, то краще.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: We should gather at the hideout[n]as soon as possible.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: So, what will it be? Should we assemble[n]at the hideout and send the calling card?
entries.uk: Ну, що вирішиш? Зберемося в схованці[n]й надішлемо картку?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: I'll head to the hideout immediately.
